scope_change_triggers: Repeating the exact eight-term all-pairs search inside its proved scope.

actual_scope: Every exact nine-term complex factorization of 2G plus one nonzero odd-entry correction on P112 has separate copy cost at least 64 and power bill at least 8*8^q for 0<q<=1.
scope_change_reason: The masked/overcomplete card is narrowed to a singleton odd-entry completion with all nine factor terms free. A sharp obstruction is obtained before physical synthesis; the eight-term all-pairs premise is changed.
bottleneck_link: The complex side binds at the pinned selected record. A free odd correction with unrestricted factor changes is a concrete decoder mechanism; this rules out copy-cost improvement for one-entry rank-nine completions, while leaving other supplier charges and larger corrections open.
stop_rule: Stop this one-entry mechanism once the exact support classification and coupled compensation proof exclude any improvement in the separate copy power bill. No larger search or physical synthesis is warranted within this scope.
evidence: PROOF.md; CERTIFICATE.json; complete finite replay; five Q(i) fixtures; thirteen semantic tests with twelve failure controls.
author: Arham Tahir (@Arham-Tahir64), with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance
ai_assistance: Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in choosing/refining the task, deriving the proof, implementing the checker and controls, and preparing the documentation and submission.
